narr: Thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. One storm produced flash flooding in downstream of the Bighorn burn scar in Finger Rock Canyon.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 on the Bighorn burn scar caused rapid rises in Finger Rock Wash. Road closures resulted near Havasu Rd and Columbus Blvd and Pontatoc Rd. south of Skyline Dr.
lsr: HAVASU RD EAST OF COLUMBUS BL CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
PONTATOC RD SOUTH OF SKYLINE DR CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
